title: Feathers, Hooves & Independence
intro: Welcome to your Advent calendar, Meg! 🐦🐴🇲🇽

puzzles.prompt: Which bird is the only one known to be able to fly backwards?
puzzles.explanation: Hummingbirds can hover, fly backwards, and even briefly fly upside down.

puzzles.prompt: Mexico’s War of Independence began in 1810 with the "Grito de Dolores." Which priest gave the famous cry?
puzzles.explanation: Father Miguel Hidalgo rang the church bell in Dolores on September 16, 1810 — now Mexican Independence Day.

puzzles.prompt: A horse’s height is measured in "hands." How many inches is one hand?
puzzles.explanation: One hand = 4 inches, measured from the ground to the top of the withers.

puzzles.hint: A wading bird with snowy plumes.

puzzles.prompt: Find four groups of four that share something in common.
puzzles.explanation: KITE is a bird of prey, and STAR is a face marking — not something you fly or wish upon!
